projects.title: Discount Drain Cleaning
projects.description:
The Challenge

When Discount Drain Cleaning came to us, their growth was clogged — no leads, no engagement, no direction on social. They had the skills and the crew, but zero digital presence.

The Solution

We rebuilt their presence from the pipes up: a full-funnel content engine featuring laugh-out-loud skits, real-trade education, and service-driven posts. We orchestrated 30 reels a month and weekly on-location shoots with the crew, turning the plumbers themselves into personalities people wanted to follow.

The Results

  • Views: Exploded from under 30K to 2M+
  • Likes: Surged from 2K to 200K
  • TikTok: Built from 0 to 3,500 followers — 100% organic, ZERO ad spend

The tagline: "They called for a plumber. The whole internet showed up. Vegas is FLOWING."

Impact

From clogged growth to unstoppable momentum. Discount Drain went from a local service business to a viral content phenomenon, proving that authenticity, humor, and strategic consistency can turn any industry into entertainment.
